Description: Post new Umbraco 17 content to LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon. When configured document types are published for the first time, the title, link, summary and image go into a queue and a background service posts them with retries. A post is never sent twice to the same network unless you force it. Credentials come from configuration or are stored encrypted. The backoffice never shows a stored secret. A Settings dashboard shows each network, the queue with retry and cancel, a post now action and share links for X, Facebook and LinkedIn. Free and MIT licensed.
